/**
 * A mock backend: it answers `tp-run-request` with the events a real backend would stream,
 * pushed with `pushRunEvent` after short delays. Node data scripts each outcome: `wait` pauses
 * the node with a reason, `warning` reports one, `error` fails it (and the run), `port` picks the
 * branch it finishes through. A node whose inputs are not connected is skipped.
 * @param {HTMLElement & Record<string, any>} flow
 * @returns {{ request: (event: CustomEvent) => void, dispose: () => void }}
 */
function mockBackend(flow) {
  const view = flow.ownerDocument.defaultView;
  let token = 0;
  const timers = new Set();
  const delay = (ms) =>
    new Promise((resolve) => {
      const timer = view.setTimeout(() => {
        timers.delete(timer);
        resolve(undefined);
      }, ms);
      timers.add(timer);
    });
  const push = (event) => flow.pushRunEvent({ ...event, at: view.performance.now() });
  const halt = () => {
    token += 1;
    for (const timer of timers) view.clearTimeout(timer);
    timers.clear();
  };
  async function run(detail) {
    halt();
    const run = token;
    const alive = () => run === token;
    const { nodeIds, scope } = detail;
    const covered = new Set(nodeIds);
    const edges = flow.edges;
    const definitionOf = (node) => flow.schema?.nodes.find((item) => item.type === node.type);
    // Roots: nodes the run reaches without an edge from inside the scope. A root whose inputs
    // have no edge at all is not connected and is skipped.
    const reached = new Set(
      nodeIds.filter((id) => {
        if (edges.some((edge) => edge.target === id && covered.has(edge.source))) return false;
        const node = flow.nodes.find((item) => item.id === id);
        const inputs = (definitionOf(node)?.ports ?? []).filter(
          (port) => port.direction === 'input',
        );
        return inputs.length === 0 || edges.some((edge) => edge.target === id);
      }),
    );
    push({ type: 'run_started', ...(scope === 'graph' ? {} : { scope: nodeIds }) });
    for (const nodeId of nodeIds) {
      if (!alive()) return;
      if (!reached.has(nodeId)) {
        push({ type: 'node_skipped', nodeId, reason: 'not reached' });
        continue;
      }
      const data = flow.nodes.find((item) => item.id === nodeId)?.data ?? {};
      push({ type: 'node_started', nodeId });
      for (const progress of [0.35, 0.7]) {
        await delay(350);
        if (!alive()) return;
        push({ type: 'node_progress', nodeId, progress });
      }
      if (data.wait) {
        push({ type: 'node_waiting', nodeId, reason: data.wait });
        await delay(1600);
        if (!alive()) return;
      }
      await delay(350);
      if (!alive()) return;
      if (data.warning) push({ type: 'node_warning', nodeId, message: data.warning });
      if (data.error) {
        push({ type: 'node_failed', nodeId, error: data.error });
        push({ type: 'run_failed', error: data.error });
        return;
      }
      push({ type: 'node_completed', nodeId, ...(data.port ? { port: data.port } : {}) });
      for (const edge of edges)
        if (edge.source === nodeId && (!data.port || edge.sourcePort === data.port))
          reached.add(edge.target);
    }
    if (alive()) push({ type: 'run_completed' });
  }
  return {
    request: (event) => {
      const { action } = event.detail;
      if (action === 'run') void run(event.detail);
      else if (action === 'stop') {
        halt();
        push({ type: 'run_cancelled' });
      } else if (action === 'clear') {
        halt();
        flow.clearRun();
      }
    },
    dispose: halt,
  };
}

/**
 * @param {HTMLElement} root
 * @returns {() => void} cleanup
 */
export function setupFlowExample(root) {
  const cleanups = [];
  const listen = (target, type, listener) => {
    target.addEventListener(type, listener);
    cleanups.push(() => target.removeEventListener(type, listener));
  };
  const readout = (after) => {
    const output = root.ownerDocument.createElement('output');
    output.style.display = 'block';
    output.style.marginBlockStart = 'var(--tp-space-2)';
    output.style.font = 'var(--tp-text-sm) var(--tp-font-mono)';
    after.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', output);
    cleanups.push(() => output.remove());
    return output;
  };
  const summary = (document) => `${document.nodes.length} nodes, ${document.edges.length} edges`;
  // Icons of consumer Buttons in the markup (`icon` is a property).
  for (const icon of root.querySelectorAll('tp-icon[data-flow-icon]'))
    icon.icon = flowIcons[icon.getAttribute('data-flow-icon') || ''];
  for (const authored of root.querySelectorAll('tp-flow')) {
    let flow = authored;
    // The sample schema and its icons (`schema` and `icons` are properties, not attributes).
    const schema = samples[flow.getAttribute('data-schema') || ''];
    if (schema) {
      flow.schema = schema.schema;
      flow.icons = flowIcons;
    }
    // The sample document, optionally with one node pinned for the layout engine.
    const sample = samples[flow.getAttribute('data-document') || ''];
    let document = sample ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sample.document)) : undefined;
    const pinned = flow.getAttribute('data-pin');
    if (document && pinned)
      document.nodes = document.nodes.map((node) =>
        node.id === pinned ? { ...node, pinned: true } : node,
      );
    // A generated dependency graph of orthogonal edges, routed by the obstacle-aware router.
    const count = Number(flow.getAttribute('data-generate'));
    if (count > 0) {
      document = generateDocument(count, 6, 'orthogonal');
      flow.router = 'orthogonal';
    }
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-controlled')) {
      // A controlled owner. The lane fixes its mode when the element connects, so the owner creates
      // the instance with `value` set and connects it in place of the authored one; its document is
      // the state and every accepted proposal is written back.
      let owned = document || { version: 1, nodes: [], edges: [] };
      const owner = authored.cloneNode(true);
      owner.schema = authored.schema;
      owner.icons = authored.icons;
      owner.router = authored.router;
      owner.value = owned;
      authored.replaceWith(owner);
      flow = owner;
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
        if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
        owned = event.detail.value;
        flow.value = owned;
      });
    } else if (document) {
      // Uncontrolled: the document seeds the default (what Reset restores) and loads programmatically.
      flow.defaultValue = document;
      flow.load(document);
    }
    // Execution: a mock backend answers the run requests (`runnable`) with delayed run events.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-execute')) {
      const backend = mockBackend(flow);
      listen(flow, 'tp-run-request', backend.request);
      cleanups.push(backend.dispose);
    }
    // "Add task": a consumer Button that toggles the node library through its lane.
    for (const button of flow.querySelectorAll('[data-flow-palette]'))
      listen(button, 'click', (event) =>
        flow.setPaletteOpen(!flow.paletteOpen, 'trigger-press', event),
      );
    // Run state: a finished snapshot, or a trace the built-in stepper plays (`controls` lists `run`).
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-run'))
      flow.run = flow.getAttribute('data-run') === 'trace' ? sampleTrace : sampleRun;
    // Connection validation beyond the schema: the auto-reply only follows the condition. A string
    // is a rejection message; `false` rejects silently.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-validate'))
      flow.isValidConnection = (connection) =>
        connection.target !== 'reply' ||
        connection.source === 'urgent' ||
        'The auto-reply only follows the condition.';
    // Layout readout: `tp-layout-complete` carries the direction, the stats and the bounds.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-layout-readout')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      output.textContent = 'Drop a node or press the layout control to lay out';
      listen(flow, 'tp-layout-complete', (event) => {
        const { direction, stats } = event.detail;
        output.textContent = `${direction}: ${stats.layers} layers, ${stats.crossings} crossings, ${stats.components} components, ${Math.round(stats.elapsed)} ms`;
      });
    }
    // Undo and redo state: `tp-history-change` carries `canUndo`, `canRedo` and the labels of the
    // steps they would take back or forward.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-history-readout')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      const show = (state) => {
        const undo = state.canUndo ? (state.undoLabel ?? 'available') : 'nothing';
        const redo = state.canRedo ? (state.redoLabel ?? 'available') : 'nothing';
        output.textContent = `Undo: ${undo} · Redo: ${redo}`;
      };
      show({ canUndo: flow.canUndo, canRedo: flow.canRedo });
      listen(flow, 'tp-history-change', (event) => show(event.detail));
    }
    // Consumer bars: a child Button calls the public method its `data-flow-call` names; one with
    // `data-flow-enabled` follows that boolean getter on every history change.
    const commands = [...flow.querySelectorAll('[data-flow-call]')];
    if (commands.length) {
      const refresh = () => {
        for (const button of commands)
          if (button.dataset.flowEnabled) button.disabled = !flow[button.dataset.flowEnabled];
      };
      for (const button of commands)
        listen(button, 'click', () => flow[button.dataset.flowCall]('trigger-press'));
      listen(flow, 'tp-history-change', refresh);
      refresh();
    }
    // Live readout: proposals with their reason and change types, commits, connections.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-output')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      output.textContent = summary(flow.value);
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
        if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
        const types = [...new Set(event.detail.metadata.changes.map((change) => change.type))];
        const where = event.detail.metadata.nodeId
          ? ` on ${event.detail.metadata.nodeId}${event.detail.metadata.property ? `.${event.detail.metadata.property}` : ''}`
          : '';
        output.textContent = `${event.detail.reason}: ${types.join(', ')}${where}`;
      });
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-commit', (event) => {
        output.textContent = `${summary(event.detail.value)} (committed: ${event.detail.reason})`;
      });
      listen(flow, 'tp-connect', (event) => {
        const { connection } = event.detail;
        output.textContent = `connect: ${connection.source} → ${connection.target}`;
      });
    }
  }
  // A layout switch: the Toggle group's value becomes `autoLayout` and lays the graph out.
  for (const group of root.querySelectorAll('tp-toggle-group[data-layout-switch]')) {
    const flow = root.querySelector(`#${group.getAttribute('data-layout-switch')}`);
    if (!flow) continue;
    listen(group, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
      const [mode] = event.detail.value;
      if (!mode) {
        event.preventDefault();
        return;
      }
      flow.autoLayout = mode;
      flow.layout(mode);
    });
  }
  // Form submit readout: the document submits as JSON under the widget's name.
  for (const form of root.querySelectorAll('tp-form[data-form-output]')) {
    const output = readout(form);
    listen(form, 'tp-submit', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const entries = [...event.detail.data.entries()].map(
        ([name, value]) => `${name}=${String(value).slice(0, 72)}…`,
      );
      output.textContent = entries.join('; ') || '(no entries)';
    });
  }
  return () => {
    for (const cleanup of cleanups.splice(0).reverse()) cleanup();
  };
}

setupFlowExample(document.getElementById('flow-stage-lighting'));

items.title: Vertical pipeline
items.description: Compact icon nodes with ports on their top and bottom sides, orthogonal edges routed around the nodes, arrow markers and branch labels as Badge pills. The build path is `animated`: its dashed stroke marches from source to target (a closed arrow keeps the direction when reduced motion pauses it). `palette` puts the node library in a sidebar at the inline start, opened by the floating "+", with a section per category of the schema; drag a chip onto the canvas, or click it and then the canvas. Every label carries a "+" Button that opens the library for an insertion on that edge, and releasing a connection on the empty pane does the same at the drop point.

/**
 * Documentation example wiring for `tp-flow`. Every example uses only the public API:
 * properties (`schema`, `icons`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `run`, `router`, `isValidConnection`,
 * `autoLayout`), methods (`load`, `layout`, `deleteElements`), the lane events
 * (`tp-value-change` / `tp-value-commit`), `tp-connect`, `tp-delete`, `tp-layout-complete` and the
 * Form submit event. The `data-*` attributes are example setup, not component properties: they
 * pick the sample schema and document because `schema` and `icons` are property-only.
 */

/**
 * A grid of generic action nodes chained left to right and top to bottom, for the read-only
 * dependency viewer.
 * @param {number} count
 * @param {number} [columns]
 * @param {'bezier' | 'straight' | 'step' | 'smoothstep' | 'orthogonal'} [kind]
 */
export function generateDocument(count, columns = 25, kind) {
  const nodes = [];
  const edges = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    nodes.push({
      id: `n${i}`,
      type: 'action',
      position: { x: (i % columns) * 300, y: Math.floor(i / columns) * 160 },
      data: {},
      label: `Node ${i}`,
    });
    if (i > 0)
      edges.push({
        id: `g${i}`,
        source: `n${i - 1}`,
        sourcePort: 'out',
        target: `n${i}`,
        targetPort: 'in',
        ...(kind ? { kind } : {}),
      });
    if (i >= columns)
      edges.push({
        id: `v${i}`,
        source: `n${i - columns}`,
        sourcePort: 'out',
        target: `n${i}`,
        targetPort: 'in',
        ...(kind ? { kind } : {}),
      });
  }
  return { version: 1, nodes, edges };
}

/**
 * A mock backend: it answers `tp-run-request` with the events a real backend would stream,
 * pushed with `pushRunEvent` after short delays. Node data scripts each outcome: `wait` pauses
 * the node with a reason, `warning` reports one, `error` fails it (and the run), `port` picks the
 * branch it finishes through. A node whose inputs are not connected is skipped.
 * @param {HTMLElement & Record<string, any>} flow
 * @returns {{ request: (event: CustomEvent) => void, dispose: () => void }}
 */
function mockBackend(flow) {
  const view = flow.ownerDocument.defaultView;
  let token = 0;
  const timers = new Set();
  const delay = (ms) =>
    new Promise((resolve) => {
      const timer = view.setTimeout(() => {
        timers.delete(timer);
        resolve(undefined);
      }, ms);
      timers.add(timer);
    });
  const push = (event) => flow.pushRunEvent({ ...event, at: view.performance.now() });
  const halt = () => {
    token += 1;
    for (const timer of timers) view.clearTimeout(timer);
    timers.clear();
  };
  async function run(detail) {
    halt();
    const run = token;
    const alive = () => run === token;
    const { nodeIds, scope } = detail;
    const covered = new Set(nodeIds);
    const edges = flow.edges;
    const definitionOf = (node) => flow.schema?.nodes.find((item) => item.type === node.type);
    // Roots: nodes the run reaches without an edge from inside the scope. A root whose inputs
    // have no edge at all is not connected and is skipped.
    const reached = new Set(
      nodeIds.filter((id) => {
        if (edges.some((edge) => edge.target === id && covered.has(edge.source))) return false;
        const node = flow.nodes.find((item) => item.id === id);
        const inputs = (definitionOf(node)?.ports ?? []).filter(
          (port) => port.direction === 'input',
        );
        return inputs.length === 0 || edges.some((edge) => edge.target === id);
      }),
    );
    push({ type: 'run_started', ...(scope === 'graph' ? {} : { scope: nodeIds }) });
    for (const nodeId of nodeIds) {
      if (!alive()) return;
      if (!reached.has(nodeId)) {
        push({ type: 'node_skipped', nodeId, reason: 'not reached' });
        continue;
      }
      const data = flow.nodes.find((item) => item.id === nodeId)?.data ?? {};
      push({ type: 'node_started', nodeId });
      for (const progress of [0.35, 0.7]) {
        await delay(350);
        if (!alive()) return;
        push({ type: 'node_progress', nodeId, progress });
      }
      if (data.wait) {
        push({ type: 'node_waiting', nodeId, reason: data.wait });
        await delay(1600);
        if (!alive()) return;
      }
      await delay(350);
      if (!alive()) return;
      if (data.warning) push({ type: 'node_warning', nodeId, message: data.warning });
      if (data.error) {
        push({ type: 'node_failed', nodeId, error: data.error });
        push({ type: 'run_failed', error: data.error });
        return;
      }
      push({ type: 'node_completed', nodeId, ...(data.port ? { port: data.port } : {}) });
      for (const edge of edges)
        if (edge.source === nodeId && (!data.port || edge.sourcePort === data.port))
          reached.add(edge.target);
    }
    if (alive()) push({ type: 'run_completed' });
  }
  return {
    request: (event) => {
      const { action } = event.detail;
      if (action === 'run') void run(event.detail);
      else if (action === 'stop') {
        halt();
        push({ type: 'run_cancelled' });
      } else if (action === 'clear') {
        halt();
        flow.clearRun();
      }
    },
    dispose: halt,
  };
}

/**
 * @param {HTMLElement} root
 * @returns {() => void} cleanup
 */
export function setupFlowExample(root) {
  const cleanups = [];
  const listen = (target, type, listener) => {
    target.addEventListener(type, listener);
    cleanups.push(() => target.removeEventListener(type, listener));
  };
  const readout = (after) => {
    const output = root.ownerDocument.createElement('output');
    output.style.display = 'block';
    output.style.marginBlockStart = 'var(--tp-space-2)';
    output.style.font = 'var(--tp-text-sm) var(--tp-font-mono)';
    after.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', output);
    cleanups.push(() => output.remove());
    return output;
  };
  const summary = (document) => `${document.nodes.length} nodes, ${document.edges.length} edges`;
  // Icons of consumer Buttons in the markup (`icon` is a property).
  for (const icon of root.querySelectorAll('tp-icon[data-flow-icon]'))
    icon.icon = flowIcons[icon.getAttribute('data-flow-icon') || ''];
  for (const authored of root.querySelectorAll('tp-flow')) {
    let flow = authored;
    // The sample schema and its icons (`schema` and `icons` are properties, not attributes).
    const schema = samples[flow.getAttribute('data-schema') || ''];
    if (schema) {
      flow.schema = schema.schema;
      flow.icons = flowIcons;
    }
    // The sample document, optionally with one node pinned for the layout engine.
    const sample = samples[flow.getAttribute('data-document') || ''];
    let document = sample ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sample.document)) : undefined;
    const pinned = flow.getAttribute('data-pin');
    if (document && pinned)
      document.nodes = document.nodes.map((node) =>
        node.id === pinned ? { ...node, pinned: true } : node,
      );
    // A generated dependency graph of orthogonal edges, routed by the obstacle-aware router.
    const count = Number(flow.getAttribute('data-generate'));
    if (count > 0) {
      document = generateDocument(count, 6, 'orthogonal');
      flow.router = 'orthogonal';
    }
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-controlled')) {
      // A controlled owner. The lane fixes its mode when the element connects, so the owner creates
      // the instance with `value` set and connects it in place of the authored one; its document is
      // the state and every accepted proposal is written back.
      let owned = document || { version: 1, nodes: [], edges: [] };
      const owner = authored.cloneNode(true);
      owner.schema = authored.schema;
      owner.icons = authored.icons;
      owner.router = authored.router;
      owner.value = owned;
      authored.replaceWith(owner);
      flow = owner;
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
        if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
        owned = event.detail.value;
        flow.value = owned;
      });
    } else if (document) {
      // Uncontrolled: the document seeds the default (what Reset restores) and loads programmatically.
      flow.defaultValue = document;
      flow.load(document);
    }
    // Execution: a mock backend answers the run requests (`runnable`) with delayed run events.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-execute')) {
      const backend = mockBackend(flow);
      listen(flow, 'tp-run-request', backend.request);
      cleanups.push(backend.dispose);
    }
    // "Add task": a consumer Button that toggles the node library through its lane.
    for (const button of flow.querySelectorAll('[data-flow-palette]'))
      listen(button, 'click', (event) =>
        flow.setPaletteOpen(!flow.paletteOpen, 'trigger-press', event),
      );
    // Run state: a finished snapshot, or a trace the built-in stepper plays (`controls` lists `run`).
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-run'))
      flow.run = flow.getAttribute('data-run') === 'trace' ? sampleTrace : sampleRun;
    // Connection validation beyond the schema: the auto-reply only follows the condition. A string
    // is a rejection message; `false` rejects silently.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-validate'))
      flow.isValidConnection = (connection) =>
        connection.target !== 'reply' ||
        connection.source === 'urgent' ||
        'The auto-reply only follows the condition.';
    // Layout readout: `tp-layout-complete` carries the direction, the stats and the bounds.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-layout-readout')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      output.textContent = 'Drop a node or press the layout control to lay out';
      listen(flow, 'tp-layout-complete', (event) => {
        const { direction, stats } = event.detail;
        output.textContent = `${direction}: ${stats.layers} layers, ${stats.crossings} crossings, ${stats.components} components, ${Math.round(stats.elapsed)} ms`;
      });
    }
    // Undo and redo state: `tp-history-change` carries `canUndo`, `canRedo` and the labels of the
    // steps they would take back or forward.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-history-readout')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      const show = (state) => {
        const undo = state.canUndo ? (state.undoLabel ?? 'available') : 'nothing';
        const redo = state.canRedo ? (state.redoLabel ?? 'available') : 'nothing';
        output.textContent = `Undo: ${undo} · Redo: ${redo}`;
      };
      show({ canUndo: flow.canUndo, canRedo: flow.canRedo });
      listen(flow, 'tp-history-change', (event) => show(event.detail));
    }
    // Consumer bars: a child Button calls the public method its `data-flow-call` names; one with
    // `data-flow-enabled` follows that boolean getter on every history change.
    const commands = [...flow.querySelectorAll('[data-flow-call]')];
    if (commands.length) {
      const refresh = () => {
        for (const button of commands)
          if (button.dataset.flowEnabled) button.disabled = !flow[button.dataset.flowEnabled];
      };
      for (const button of commands)
        listen(button, 'click', () => flow[button.dataset.flowCall]('trigger-press'));
      listen(flow, 'tp-history-change', refresh);
      refresh();
    }
    // Live readout: proposals with their reason and change types, commits, connections.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-output')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      output.textContent = summary(flow.value);
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
        if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
        const types = [...new Set(event.detail.metadata.changes.map((change) => change.type))];
        const where = event.detail.metadata.nodeId
          ? ` on ${event.detail.metadata.nodeId}${event.detail.metadata.property ? `.${event.detail.metadata.property}` : ''}`
          : '';
        output.textContent = `${event.detail.reason}: ${types.join(', ')}${where}`;
      });
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-commit', (event) => {
        output.textContent = `${summary(event.detail.value)} (committed: ${event.detail.reason})`;
      });
      listen(flow, 'tp-connect', (event) => {
        const { connection } = event.detail;
        output.textContent = `connect: ${connection.source} → ${connection.target}`;
      });
    }
  }
  // A layout switch: the Toggle group's value becomes `autoLayout` and lays the graph out.
  for (const group of root.querySelectorAll('tp-toggle-group[data-layout-switch]')) {
    const flow = root.querySelector(`#${group.getAttribute('data-layout-switch')}`);
    if (!flow) continue;
    listen(group, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
      const [mode] = event.detail.value;
      if (!mode) {
        event.preventDefault();
        return;
      }
      flow.autoLayout = mode;
      flow.layout(mode);
    });
  }
  // Form submit readout: the document submits as JSON under the widget's name.
  for (const form of root.querySelectorAll('tp-form[data-form-output]')) {
    const output = readout(form);
    listen(form, 'tp-submit', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const entries = [...event.detail.data.entries()].map(
        ([name, value]) => `${name}=${String(value).slice(0, 72)}…`,
      );
      output.textContent = entries.join('; ') || '(no entries)';
    });
  }
  return () => {
    for (const cleanup of cleanups.splice(0).reverse()) cleanup();
  };
}

setupFlowExample(document.getElementById('flow-vertical-pipeline'));

items.title: Pipeline with inspector
items.description: The inspector holds the settings the schema keeps off the node: compact nodes have no body rows, so their properties default to `placement: "inspector"`. Double press a step or the approval (or use Settings in the node toolbar or the context menu) to open it; it floats over the canvas at the inline end and slides in like a Sheet, follows a single selected node with settings and closes when the selection leaves them. Settings edits those properties through the library control each one names, Wiring lists the connections, Run shows the status. `inspector-commit="explicit"` keeps edits local until Save (one proposal per edited key) and Cancel reverts them.

/**
 * Documentation example wiring for `tp-flow`. Every example uses only the public API:
 * properties (`schema`, `icons`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `run`, `router`, `isValidConnection`,
 * `autoLayout`), methods (`load`, `layout`, `deleteElements`), the lane events
 * (`tp-value-change` / `tp-value-commit`), `tp-connect`, `tp-delete`, `tp-layout-complete` and the
 * Form submit event. The `data-*` attributes are example setup, not component properties: they
 * pick the sample schema and document because `schema` and `icons` are property-only.
 */

/**
 * A grid of generic action nodes chained left to right and top to bottom, for the read-only
 * dependency viewer.
 * @param {number} count
 * @param {number} [columns]
 * @param {'bezier' | 'straight' | 'step' | 'smoothstep' | 'orthogonal'} [kind]
 */
export function generateDocument(count, columns = 25, kind) {
  const nodes = [];
  const edges = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    nodes.push({
      id: `n${i}`,
      type: 'action',
      position: { x: (i % columns) * 300, y: Math.floor(i / columns) * 160 },
      data: {},
      label: `Node ${i}`,
    });
    if (i > 0)
      edges.push({
        id: `g${i}`,
        source: `n${i - 1}`,
        sourcePort: 'out',
        target: `n${i}`,
        targetPort: 'in',
        ...(kind ? { kind } : {}),
      });
    if (i >= columns)
      edges.push({
        id: `v${i}`,
        source: `n${i - columns}`,
        sourcePort: 'out',
        target: `n${i}`,
        targetPort: 'in',
        ...(kind ? { kind } : {}),
      });
  }
  return { version: 1, nodes, edges };
}

/**
 * A mock backend: it answers `tp-run-request` with the events a real backend would stream,
 * pushed with `pushRunEvent` after short delays. Node data scripts each outcome: `wait` pauses
 * the node with a reason, `warning` reports one, `error` fails it (and the run), `port` picks the
 * branch it finishes through. A node whose inputs are not connected is skipped.
 * @param {HTMLElement & Record<string, any>} flow
 * @returns {{ request: (event: CustomEvent) => void, dispose: () => void }}
 */
function mockBackend(flow) {
  const view = flow.ownerDocument.defaultView;
  let token = 0;
  const timers = new Set();
  const delay = (ms) =>
    new Promise((resolve) => {
      const timer = view.setTimeout(() => {
        timers.delete(timer);
        resolve(undefined);
      }, ms);
      timers.add(timer);
    });
  const push = (event) => flow.pushRunEvent({ ...event, at: view.performance.now() });
  const halt = () => {
    token += 1;
    for (const timer of timers) view.clearTimeout(timer);
    timers.clear();
  };
  async function run(detail) {
    halt();
    const run = token;
    const alive = () => run === token;
    const { nodeIds, scope } = detail;
    const covered = new Set(nodeIds);
    const edges = flow.edges;
    const definitionOf = (node) => flow.schema?.nodes.find((item) => item.type === node.type);
    // Roots: nodes the run reaches without an edge from inside the scope. A root whose inputs
    // have no edge at all is not connected and is skipped.
    const reached = new Set(
      nodeIds.filter((id) => {
        if (edges.some((edge) => edge.target === id && covered.has(edge.source))) return false;
        const node = flow.nodes.find((item) => item.id === id);
        const inputs = (definitionOf(node)?.ports ?? []).filter(
          (port) => port.direction === 'input',
        );
        return inputs.length === 0 || edges.some((edge) => edge.target === id);
      }),
    );
    push({ type: 'run_started', ...(scope === 'graph' ? {} : { scope: nodeIds }) });
    for (const nodeId of nodeIds) {
      if (!alive()) return;
      if (!reached.has(nodeId)) {
        push({ type: 'node_skipped', nodeId, reason: 'not reached' });
        continue;
      }
      const data = flow.nodes.find((item) => item.id === nodeId)?.data ?? {};
      push({ type: 'node_started', nodeId });
      for (const progress of [0.35, 0.7]) {
        await delay(350);
        if (!alive()) return;
        push({ type: 'node_progress', nodeId, progress });
      }
      if (data.wait) {
        push({ type: 'node_waiting', nodeId, reason: data.wait });
        await delay(1600);
        if (!alive()) return;
      }
      await delay(350);
      if (!alive()) return;
      if (data.warning) push({ type: 'node_warning', nodeId, message: data.warning });
      if (data.error) {
        push({ type: 'node_failed', nodeId, error: data.error });
        push({ type: 'run_failed', error: data.error });
        return;
      }
      push({ type: 'node_completed', nodeId, ...(data.port ? { port: data.port } : {}) });
      for (const edge of edges)
        if (edge.source === nodeId && (!data.port || edge.sourcePort === data.port))
          reached.add(edge.target);
    }
    if (alive()) push({ type: 'run_completed' });
  }
  return {
    request: (event) => {
      const { action } = event.detail;
      if (action === 'run') void run(event.detail);
      else if (action === 'stop') {
        halt();
        push({ type: 'run_cancelled' });
      } else if (action === 'clear') {
        halt();
        flow.clearRun();
      }
    },
    dispose: halt,
  };
}

/**
 * @param {HTMLElement} root
 * @returns {() => void} cleanup
 */
export function setupFlowExample(root) {
  const cleanups = [];
  const listen = (target, type, listener) => {
    target.addEventListener(type, listener);
    cleanups.push(() => target.removeEventListener(type, listener));
  };
  const readout = (after) => {
    const output = root.ownerDocument.createElement('output');
    output.style.display = 'block';
    output.style.marginBlockStart = 'var(--tp-space-2)';
    output.style.font = 'var(--tp-text-sm) var(--tp-font-mono)';
    after.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', output);
    cleanups.push(() => output.remove());
    return output;
  };
  const summary = (document) => `${document.nodes.length} nodes, ${document.edges.length} edges`;
  // Icons of consumer Buttons in the markup (`icon` is a property).
  for (const icon of root.querySelectorAll('tp-icon[data-flow-icon]'))
    icon.icon = flowIcons[icon.getAttribute('data-flow-icon') || ''];
  for (const authored of root.querySelectorAll('tp-flow')) {
    let flow = authored;
    // The sample schema and its icons (`schema` and `icons` are properties, not attributes).
    const schema = samples[flow.getAttribute('data-schema') || ''];
    if (schema) {
      flow.schema = schema.schema;
      flow.icons = flowIcons;
    }
    // The sample document, optionally with one node pinned for the layout engine.
    const sample = samples[flow.getAttribute('data-document') || ''];
    let document = sample ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sample.document)) : undefined;
    const pinned = flow.getAttribute('data-pin');
    if (document && pinned)
      document.nodes = document.nodes.map((node) =>
        node.id === pinned ? { ...node, pinned: true } : node,
      );
    // A generated dependency graph of orthogonal edges, routed by the obstacle-aware router.
    const count = Number(flow.getAttribute('data-generate'));
    if (count > 0) {
      document = generateDocument(count, 6, 'orthogonal');
      flow.router = 'orthogonal';
    }
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-controlled')) {
      // A controlled owner. The lane fixes its mode when the element connects, so the owner creates
      // the instance with `value` set and connects it in place of the authored one; its document is
      // the state and every accepted proposal is written back.
      let owned = document || { version: 1, nodes: [], edges: [] };
      const owner = authored.cloneNode(true);
      owner.schema = authored.schema;
      owner.icons = authored.icons;
      owner.router = authored.router;
      owner.value = owned;
      authored.replaceWith(owner);
      flow = owner;
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
        if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
        owned = event.detail.value;
        flow.value = owned;
      });
    } else if (document) {
      // Uncontrolled: the document seeds the default (what Reset restores) and loads programmatically.
      flow.defaultValue = document;
      flow.load(document);
    }
    // Execution: a mock backend answers the run requests (`runnable`) with delayed run events.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-execute')) {
      const backend = mockBackend(flow);
      listen(flow, 'tp-run-request', backend.request);
      cleanups.push(backend.dispose);
    }
    // "Add task": a consumer Button that toggles the node library through its lane.
    for (const button of flow.querySelectorAll('[data-flow-palette]'))
      listen(button, 'click', (event) =>
        flow.setPaletteOpen(!flow.paletteOpen, 'trigger-press', event),
      );
    // Run state: a finished snapshot, or a trace the built-in stepper plays (`controls` lists `run`).
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-run'))
      flow.run = flow.getAttribute('data-run') === 'trace' ? sampleTrace : sampleRun;
    // Connection validation beyond the schema: the auto-reply only follows the condition. A string
    // is a rejection message; `false` rejects silently.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-validate'))
      flow.isValidConnection = (connection) =>
        connection.target !== 'reply' ||
        connection.source === 'urgent' ||
        'The auto-reply only follows the condition.';
    // Layout readout: `tp-layout-complete` carries the direction, the stats and the bounds.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-layout-readout')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      output.textContent = 'Drop a node or press the layout control to lay out';
      listen(flow, 'tp-layout-complete', (event) => {
        const { direction, stats } = event.detail;
        output.textContent = `${direction}: ${stats.layers} layers, ${stats.crossings} crossings, ${stats.components} components, ${Math.round(stats.elapsed)} ms`;
      });
    }
    // Undo and redo state: `tp-history-change` carries `canUndo`, `canRedo` and the labels of the
    // steps they would take back or forward.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-history-readout')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      const show = (state) => {
        const undo = state.canUndo ? (state.undoLabel ?? 'available') : 'nothing';
        const redo = state.canRedo ? (state.redoLabel ?? 'available') : 'nothing';
        output.textContent = `Undo: ${undo} · Redo: ${redo}`;
      };
      show({ canUndo: flow.canUndo, canRedo: flow.canRedo });
      listen(flow, 'tp-history-change', (event) => show(event.detail));
    }
    // Consumer bars: a child Button calls the public method its `data-flow-call` names; one with
    // `data-flow-enabled` follows that boolean getter on every history change.
    const commands = [...flow.querySelectorAll('[data-flow-call]')];
    if (commands.length) {
      const refresh = () => {
        for (const button of commands)
          if (button.dataset.flowEnabled) button.disabled = !flow[button.dataset.flowEnabled];
      };
      for (const button of commands)
        listen(button, 'click', () => flow[button.dataset.flowCall]('trigger-press'));
      listen(flow, 'tp-history-change', refresh);
      refresh();
    }
    // Live readout: proposals with their reason and change types, commits, connections.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-output')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      output.textContent = summary(flow.value);
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
        if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
        const types = [...new Set(event.detail.metadata.changes.map((change) => change.type))];
        const where = event.detail.metadata.nodeId
          ? ` on ${event.detail.metadata.nodeId}${event.detail.metadata.property ? `.${event.detail.metadata.property}` : ''}`
          : '';
        output.textContent = `${event.detail.reason}: ${types.join(', ')}${where}`;
      });
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-commit', (event) => {
        output.textContent = `${summary(event.detail.value)} (committed: ${event.detail.reason})`;
      });
      listen(flow, 'tp-connect', (event) => {
        const { connection } = event.detail;
        output.textContent = `connect: ${connection.source} → ${connection.target}`;
      });
    }
  }
  // A layout switch: the Toggle group's value becomes `autoLayout` and lays the graph out.
  for (const group of root.querySelectorAll('tp-toggle-group[data-layout-switch]')) {
    const flow = root.querySelector(`#${group.getAttribute('data-layout-switch')}`);
    if (!flow) continue;
    listen(group, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
      const [mode] = event.detail.value;
      if (!mode) {
        event.preventDefault();
        return;
      }
      flow.autoLayout = mode;
      flow.layout(mode);
    });
  }
  // Form submit readout: the document submits as JSON under the widget's name.
  for (const form of root.querySelectorAll('tp-form[data-form-output]')) {
    const output = readout(form);
    listen(form, 'tp-submit', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const entries = [...event.detail.data.entries()].map(
        ([name, value]) => `${name}=${String(value).slice(0, 72)}…`,
      );
      output.textContent = entries.join('; ') || '(no entries)';
    });
  }
  return () => {
    for (const cleanup of cleanups.splice(0).reverse()) cleanup();
  };
}

setupFlowExample(document.getElementById('flow-pipeline-with-inspector'));

items.title: Execution and debugging
items.description: Everything here is opt-in. `runnable` turns on run requests: Run in the `execute` control (Stop while a run is going, and a menu of scopes), Run node in the node toolbar, Run node, Run from here and Run up to here in the context menu, and Mod+Enter. The widget never executes anything: it dispatches `tp-run-request` with the action, the scope and the node ids in execution order, and the backend answers with run events through `pushRunEvent()`. This example's mock backend streams them with short delays: a node waits for an approval and reports a warning, another fails. Nodes show their progress, waiting reason, warnings and errors; `run-summary` counts the nodes per status. `validate` shows design problems before any run: "Purge CDN cache" has an unconnected required input. The header slots (`header-start`, `header-center`, `header-end`) hold the breadcrumb, the summary and the actions, and the header only appears when one of them has content.

/**
 * Documentation example wiring for `tp-flow`. Every example uses only the public API:
 * properties (`schema`, `icons`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `run`, `router`, `isValidConnection`,
 * `autoLayout`), methods (`load`, `layout`, `deleteElements`), the lane events
 * (`tp-value-change` / `tp-value-commit`), `tp-connect`, `tp-delete`, `tp-layout-complete` and the
 * Form submit event. The `data-*` attributes are example setup, not component properties: they
 * pick the sample schema and document because `schema` and `icons` are property-only.

/**
 * A grid of generic action nodes chained left to right and top to bottom, for the read-only
 * dependency viewer.
 * @param {number} count
 * @param {number} [columns]
 * @param {'bezier' | 'straight' | 'step' | 'smoothstep' | 'orthogonal'} [kind]
 */
export function generateDocument(count, columns = 25, kind) {
  const nodes = [];
  const edges = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    nodes.push({
      id: `n${i}`,
      type: 'action',
      position: { x: (i % columns) * 300, y: Math.floor(i / columns) * 160 },
      data: {},
      label: `Node ${i}`,
    });
    if (i > 0)
      edges.push({
        id: `g${i}`,
        source: `n${i - 1}`,
        sourcePort: 'out',
        target: `n${i}`,
        targetPort: 'in',
        ...(kind ? { kind } : {}),
      });
    if (i >= columns)
      edges.push({
        id: `v${i}`,
        source: `n${i - columns}`,
        sourcePort: 'out',
        target: `n${i}`,
        targetPort: 'in',
        ...(kind ? { kind } : {}),
      });
  }
  return { version: 1, nodes, edges };
}

/**
 * A mock backend: it answers `tp-run-request` with the events a real backend would stream,
 * pushed with `pushRunEvent` after short delays. Node data scripts each outcome: `wait` pauses
 * the node with a reason, `warning` reports one, `error` fails it (and the run), `port` picks the
 * branch it finishes through. A node whose inputs are not connected is skipped.
 * @param {HTMLElement & Record<string, any>} flow
 * @returns {{ request: (event: CustomEvent) => void, dispose: () => void }}
 */
function mockBackend(flow) {
  const view = flow.ownerDocument.defaultView;
  let token = 0;
  const timers = new Set();
  const delay = (ms) =>
    new Promise((resolve) => {
      const timer = view.setTimeout(() => {
        timers.delete(timer);
        resolve(undefined);
      }, ms);
      timers.add(timer);
    });
  const push = (event) => flow.pushRunEvent({ ...event, at: view.performance.now() });
  const halt = () => {
    token += 1;
    for (const timer of timers) view.clearTimeout(timer);
    timers.clear();
  };
  async function run(detail) {
    halt();
    const run = token;
    const alive = () => run === token;
    const { nodeIds, scope } = detail;
    const covered = new Set(nodeIds);
    const edges = flow.edges;
    const definitionOf = (node) => flow.schema?.nodes.find((item) => item.type === node.type);
    // Roots: nodes the run reaches without an edge from inside the scope. A root whose inputs
    // have no edge at all is not connected and is skipped.
    const reached = new Set(
      nodeIds.filter((id) => {
        if (edges.some((edge) => edge.target === id && covered.has(edge.source))) return false;
        const node = flow.nodes.find((item) => item.id === id);
        const inputs = (definitionOf(node)?.ports ?? []).filter(
          (port) => port.direction === 'input',
        );
        return inputs.length === 0 || edges.some((edge) => edge.target === id);
      }),
    );
    push({ type: 'run_started', ...(scope === 'graph' ? {} : { scope: nodeIds }) });
    for (const nodeId of nodeIds) {
      if (!alive()) return;
      if (!reached.has(nodeId)) {
        push({ type: 'node_skipped', nodeId, reason: 'not reached' });
        continue;
      }
      const data = flow.nodes.find((item) => item.id === nodeId)?.data ?? {};
      push({ type: 'node_started', nodeId });
      for (const progress of [0.35, 0.7]) {
        await delay(350);
        if (!alive()) return;
        push({ type: 'node_progress', nodeId, progress });
      }
      if (data.wait) {
        push({ type: 'node_waiting', nodeId, reason: data.wait });
        await delay(1600);
        if (!alive()) return;
      }
      await delay(350);
      if (!alive()) return;
      if (data.warning) push({ type: 'node_warning', nodeId, message: data.warning });
      if (data.error) {
        push({ type: 'node_failed', nodeId, error: data.error });
        push({ type: 'run_failed', error: data.error });
        return;
      }
      push({ type: 'node_completed', nodeId, ...(data.port ? { port: data.port } : {}) });
      for (const edge of edges)
        if (edge.source === nodeId && (!data.port || edge.sourcePort === data.port))
          reached.add(edge.target);
    }
    if (alive()) push({ type: 'run_completed' });
  }
  return {
    request: (event) => {
      const { action } = event.detail;
      if (action === 'run') void run(event.detail);
      else if (action === 'stop') {
        halt();
        push({ type: 'run_cancelled' });
      } else if (action === 'clear') {
        halt();
        flow.clearRun();
      }
    },
    dispose: halt,
  };
}

/**
 * @param {HTMLElement} root
 * @returns {() => void} cleanup
 */
export function setupFlowExample(root) {
  const cleanups = [];
  const listen = (target, type, listener) => {
    target.addEventListener(type, listener);
    cleanups.push(() => target.removeEventListener(type, listener));
  };
  const readout = (after) => {
    const output = root.ownerDocument.createElement('output');
    output.style.display = 'block';
    output.style.marginBlockStart = 'var(--tp-space-2)';
    output.style.font = 'var(--tp-text-sm) var(--tp-font-mono)';
    after.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', output);
    cleanups.push(() => output.remove());
    return output;
  };
  const summary = (document) => `${document.nodes.length} nodes, ${document.edges.length} edges`;
  // Icons of consumer Buttons in the markup (`icon` is a property).
  for (const icon of root.querySelectorAll('tp-icon[data-flow-icon]'))
    icon.icon = flowIcons[icon.getAttribute('data-flow-icon') || ''];
  for (const authored of root.querySelectorAll('tp-flow')) {
    let flow = authored;
    // The sample schema and its icons (`schema` and `icons` are properties, not attributes).
    const schema = samples[flow.getAttribute('data-schema') || ''];
    if (schema) {
      flow.schema = schema.schema;
      flow.icons = flowIcons;
    }
    // The sample document, optionally with one node pinned for the layout engine.
    const sample = samples[flow.getAttribute('data-document') || ''];
    let document = sample ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sample.document)) : undefined;
    const pinned = flow.getAttribute('data-pin');
    if (document && pinned)
      document.nodes = document.nodes.map((node) =>
        node.id === pinned ? { ...node, pinned: true } : node,
      );
    // A generated dependency graph of orthogonal edges, routed by the obstacle-aware router.
    const count = Number(flow.getAttribute('data-generate'));
    if (count > 0) {
      document = generateDocument(count, 6, 'orthogonal');
      flow.router = 'orthogonal';
    }
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-controlled')) {
      // A controlled owner. The lane fixes its mode when the element connects, so the owner creates
      // the instance with `value` set and connects it in place of the authored one; its document is
      // the state and every accepted proposal is written back.
      let owned = document || { version: 1, nodes: [], edges: [] };
      const owner = authored.cloneNode(true);
      owner.schema = authored.schema;
      owner.icons = authored.icons;
      owner.router = authored.router;
      owner.value = owned;
      authored.replaceWith(owner);
      flow = owner;
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
        if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
        owned = event.detail.value;
        flow.value = owned;
      });
    } else if (document) {
      // Uncontrolled: the document seeds the default (what Reset restores) and loads programmatically.
      flow.defaultValue = document;
      flow.load(document);
    }
    // Execution: a mock backend answers the run requests (`runnable`) with delayed run events.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-execute')) {
      const backend = mockBackend(flow);
      listen(flow, 'tp-run-request', backend.request);
      cleanups.push(backend.dispose);
    }
    // "Add task": a consumer Button that toggles the node library through its lane.
    for (const button of flow.querySelectorAll('[data-flow-palette]'))
      listen(button, 'click', (event) =>
        flow.setPaletteOpen(!flow.paletteOpen, 'trigger-press', event),
      );
    // Run state: a finished snapshot, or a trace the built-in stepper plays (`controls` lists `run`).
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-run'))
      flow.run = flow.getAttribute('data-run') === 'trace' ? sampleTrace : sampleRun;
    // Connection validation beyond the schema: the auto-reply only follows the condition. A string
    // is a rejection message; `false` rejects silently.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-validate'))
      flow.isValidConnection = (connection) =>
        connection.target !== 'reply' ||
        connection.source === 'urgent' ||
        'The auto-reply only follows the condition.';
    // Layout readout: `tp-layout-complete` carries the direction, the stats and the bounds.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-layout-readout')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      output.textContent = 'Drop a node or press the layout control to lay out';
      listen(flow, 'tp-layout-complete', (event) => {
        const { direction, stats } = event.detail;
        output.textContent = `${direction}: ${stats.layers} layers, ${stats.crossings} crossings, ${stats.components} components, ${Math.round(stats.elapsed)} ms`;
      });
    }
    // Undo and redo state: `tp-history-change` carries `canUndo`, `canRedo` and the labels of the
    // steps they would take back or forward.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-history-readout')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      const show = (state) => {
        const undo = state.canUndo ? (state.undoLabel ?? 'available') : 'nothing';
        const redo = state.canRedo ? (state.redoLabel ?? 'available') : 'nothing';
        output.textContent = `Undo: ${undo} · Redo: ${redo}`;
      };
      show({ canUndo: flow.canUndo, canRedo: flow.canRedo });
      listen(flow, 'tp-history-change', (event) => show(event.detail));
    }
    // Consumer bars: a child Button calls the public method its `data-flow-call` names; one with
    // `data-flow-enabled` follows that boolean getter on every history change.
    const commands = [...flow.querySelectorAll('[data-flow-call]')];
    if (commands.length) {
      const refresh = () => {
        for (const button of commands)
          if (button.dataset.flowEnabled) button.disabled = !flow[button.dataset.flowEnabled];
      };
      for (const button of commands)
        listen(button, 'click', () => flow[button.dataset.flowCall]('trigger-press'));
      listen(flow, 'tp-history-change', refresh);
      refresh();
    }
    // Live readout: proposals with their reason and change types, commits, connections.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-output')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      output.textContent = summary(flow.value);
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
        if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
        const types = [...new Set(event.detail.metadata.changes.map((change) => change.type))];
        const where = event.detail.metadata.nodeId
          ? ` on ${event.detail.metadata.nodeId}${event.detail.metadata.property ? `.${event.detail.metadata.property}` : ''}`
          : '';
        output.textContent = `${event.detail.reason}: ${types.join(', ')}${where}`;
      });
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-commit', (event) => {
        output.textContent = `${summary(event.detail.value)} (committed: ${event.detail.reason})`;
      });
      listen(flow, 'tp-connect', (event) => {
        const { connection } = event.detail;
        output.textContent = `connect: ${connection.source} → ${connection.target}`;
      });
    }
  }
  // A layout switch: the Toggle group's value becomes `autoLayout` and lays the graph out.
  for (const group of root.querySelectorAll('tp-toggle-group[data-layout-switch]')) {
    const flow = root.querySelector(`#${group.getAttribute('data-layout-switch')}`);
    if (!flow) continue;
    listen(group, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
      const [mode] = event.detail.value;
      if (!mode) {
        event.preventDefault();
        return;
      }
      flow.autoLayout = mode;
      flow.layout(mode);
    });
  }
  // Form submit readout: the document submits as JSON under the widget's name.
  for (const form of root.querySelectorAll('tp-form[data-form-output]')) {
    const output = readout(form);
    listen(form, 'tp-submit', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const entries = [...event.detail.data.entries()].map(
        ([name, value]) => `${name}=${String(value).slice(0, 72)}…`,
      );
      output.textContent = entries.join('; ') || '(no entries)';
    });
  }
  return () => {
    for (const cleanup of cleanups.splice(0).reverse()) cleanup();
  };
}

items.title: Animated edges
items.description: An `animated` edge draws its stroke dashed and marches the dash from source to target, so the direction of flow reads at a glance on every kind (`bezier`, `smoothstep`, `step`, `straight`, `orthogonal`). An animated edge without its own `markerEnd` gets a closed arrow, which keeps the direction visible when reduced motion pauses the dash. Set it per edge (`animated: true`, or the `animated` attribute of a `tp-flow-edge`); a running node animates its active edges the same way.

 * Documentation example wiring for `tp-flow`. Every example uses only the public API:
 * properties (`schema`, `icons`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `run`, `router`, `isValidConnection`,

 * (`tp-value-change` / `tp-value-commit`), `tp-connect`, `tp-delete`, `tp-layout-complete` and the

/**
 * A grid of generic action nodes chained left to right and top to bottom, for the read-only
 * dependency viewer.
 * @param {number} count
 * @param {number} [columns]
 * @param {'bezier' | 'straight' | 'step' | 'smoothstep' | 'orthogonal'} [kind]
 */
export function generateDocument(count, columns = 25, kind) {
  const nodes = [];
  const edges = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    nodes.push({
      id: `n${i}`,
      type: 'action',
      position: { x: (i % columns) * 300, y: Math.floor(i / columns) * 160 },
      data: {},
      label: `Node ${i}`,
    });
    if (i > 0)
      edges.push({
        id: `g${i}`,
        source: `n${i - 1}`,
        sourcePort: 'out',
        target: `n${i}`,
        targetPort: 'in',
        ...(kind ? { kind } : {}),
      });
    if (i >= columns)
      edges.push({
        id: `v${i}`,
        source: `n${i - columns}`,
        sourcePort: 'out',
        target: `n${i}`,
        targetPort: 'in',
        ...(kind ? { kind } : {}),
      });
  }
  return { version: 1, nodes, edges };
}

/**
 * A mock backend: it answers `tp-run-request` with the events a real backend would stream,
 * pushed with `pushRunEvent` after short delays. Node data scripts each outcome: `wait` pauses
 * the node with a reason, `warning` reports one, `error` fails it (and the run), `port` picks the
 * branch it finishes through. A node whose inputs are not connected is skipped.
 * @param {HTMLElement & Record<string, any>} flow
 * @returns {{ request: (event: CustomEvent) => void, dispose: () => void }}
 */
function mockBackend(flow) {
  const view = flow.ownerDocument.defaultView;
  let token = 0;
  const timers = new Set();
  const delay = (ms) =>
    new Promise((resolve) => {
      const timer = view.setTimeout(() => {
        timers.delete(timer);
        resolve(undefined);
      }, ms);
      timers.add(timer);
    });
  const push = (event) => flow.pushRunEvent({ ...event, at: view.performance.now() });
  const halt = () => {
    token += 1;
    for (const timer of timers) view.clearTimeout(timer);
    timers.clear();
  };
  async function run(detail) {
    halt();
    const run = token;
    const alive = () => run === token;
    const { nodeIds, scope } = detail;
    const covered = new Set(nodeIds);
    const edges = flow.edges;
    const definitionOf = (node) => flow.schema?.nodes.find((item) => item.type === node.type);
    // Roots: nodes the run reaches without an edge from inside the scope. A root whose inputs
    // have no edge at all is not connected and is skipped.
    const reached = new Set(
      nodeIds.filter((id) => {
        if (edges.some((edge) => edge.target === id && covered.has(edge.source))) return false;
        const node = flow.nodes.find((item) => item.id === id);
        const inputs = (definitionOf(node)?.ports ?? []).filter(
          (port) => port.direction === 'input',
        );
        return inputs.length === 0 || edges.some((edge) => edge.target === id);
      }),
    );
    push({ type: 'run_started', ...(scope === 'graph' ? {} : { scope: nodeIds }) });
    for (const nodeId of nodeIds) {
      if (!alive()) return;
      if (!reached.has(nodeId)) {
        push({ type: 'node_skipped', nodeId, reason: 'not reached' });
        continue;
      }
      const data = flow.nodes.find((item) => item.id === nodeId)?.data ?? {};
      push({ type: 'node_started', nodeId });
      for (const progress of [0.35, 0.7]) {
        await delay(350);
        if (!alive()) return;
        push({ type: 'node_progress', nodeId, progress });
      }
      if (data.wait) {
        push({ type: 'node_waiting', nodeId, reason: data.wait });
        await delay(1600);
        if (!alive()) return;
      }
      await delay(350);
      if (!alive()) return;
      if (data.warning) push({ type: 'node_warning', nodeId, message: data.warning });
      if (data.error) {
        push({ type: 'node_failed', nodeId, error: data.error });
        push({ type: 'run_failed', error: data.error });
        return;
      }
      push({ type: 'node_completed', nodeId, ...(data.port ? { port: data.port } : {}) });
      for (const edge of edges)
        if (edge.source === nodeId && (!data.port || edge.sourcePort === data.port))
          reached.add(edge.target);
    }
    if (alive()) push({ type: 'run_completed' });
  }
  return {
    request: (event) => {
      const { action } = event.detail;
      if (action === 'run') void run(event.detail);
      else if (action === 'stop') {
        halt();
        push({ type: 'run_cancelled' });
      } else if (action === 'clear') {
        halt();
        flow.clearRun();
      }
    },
    dispose: halt,
  };
}

/**
 * @param {HTMLElement} root
 * @returns {() => void} cleanup
 */
export function setupFlowExample(root) {
  const cleanups = [];
  const listen = (target, type, listener) => {
    target.addEventListener(type, listener);
    cleanups.push(() => target.removeEventListener(type, listener));
  };
  const readout = (after) => {
    const output = root.ownerDocument.createElement('output');
    output.style.display = 'block';
    output.style.marginBlockStart = 'var(--tp-space-2)';
    output.style.font = 'var(--tp-text-sm) var(--tp-font-mono)';
    after.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', output);
    cleanups.push(() => output.remove());
    return output;
  };
  const summary = (document) => `${document.nodes.length} nodes, ${document.edges.length} edges`;
  // Icons of consumer Buttons in the markup (`icon` is a property).
  for (const icon of root.querySelectorAll('tp-icon[data-flow-icon]'))
    icon.icon = flowIcons[icon.getAttribute('data-flow-icon') || ''];
  for (const authored of root.querySelectorAll('tp-flow')) {
    let flow = authored;
    // The sample schema and its icons (`schema` and `icons` are properties, not attributes).
    const schema = samples[flow.getAttribute('data-schema') || ''];
    if (schema) {
      flow.schema = schema.schema;
      flow.icons = flowIcons;
    }
    // The sample document, optionally with one node pinned for the layout engine.
    const sample = samples[flow.getAttribute('data-document') || ''];
    let document = sample ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(sample.document)) : undefined;
    const pinned = flow.getAttribute('data-pin');
    if (document && pinned)
      document.nodes = document.nodes.map((node) =>
        node.id === pinned ? { ...node, pinned: true } : node,
      );
    // A generated dependency graph of orthogonal edges, routed by the obstacle-aware router.
    const count = Number(flow.getAttribute('data-generate'));
    if (count > 0) {
      document = generateDocument(count, 6, 'orthogonal');
      flow.router = 'orthogonal';
    }
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-controlled')) {
      // A controlled owner. The lane fixes its mode when the element connects, so the owner creates
      // the instance with `value` set and connects it in place of the authored one; its document is
      // the state and every accepted proposal is written back.
      let owned = document || { version: 1, nodes: [], edges: [] };
      const owner = authored.cloneNode(true);
      owner.schema = authored.schema;
      owner.icons = authored.icons;
      owner.router = authored.router;
      owner.value = owned;
      authored.replaceWith(owner);
      flow = owner;
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
        if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
        owned = event.detail.value;
        flow.value = owned;
      });
    } else if (document) {
      // Uncontrolled: the document seeds the default (what Reset restores) and loads programmatically.
      flow.defaultValue = document;
      flow.load(document);
    }
    // Execution: a mock backend answers the run requests (`runnable`) with delayed run events.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-execute')) {
      const backend = mockBackend(flow);
      listen(flow, 'tp-run-request', backend.request);
      cleanups.push(backend.dispose);
    }
    // "Add task": a consumer Button that toggles the node library through its lane.
    for (const button of flow.querySelectorAll('[data-flow-palette]'))
      listen(button, 'click', (event) =>
        flow.setPaletteOpen(!flow.paletteOpen, 'trigger-press', event),
      );
    // Run state: a finished snapshot, or a trace the built-in stepper plays (`controls` lists `run`).
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-run'))
      flow.run = flow.getAttribute('data-run') === 'trace' ? sampleTrace : sampleRun;
    // Connection validation beyond the schema: the auto-reply only follows the condition. A string
    // is a rejection message; `false` rejects silently.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-validate'))
      flow.isValidConnection = (connection) =>
        connection.target !== 'reply' ||
        connection.source === 'urgent' ||
        'The auto-reply only follows the condition.';
    // Layout readout: `tp-layout-complete` carries the direction, the stats and the bounds.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-layout-readout')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      output.textContent = 'Drop a node or press the layout control to lay out';
      listen(flow, 'tp-layout-complete', (event) => {
        const { direction, stats } = event.detail;
        output.textContent = `${direction}: ${stats.layers} layers, ${stats.crossings} crossings, ${stats.components} components, ${Math.round(stats.elapsed)} ms`;
      });
    }
    // Undo and redo state: `tp-history-change` carries `canUndo`, `canRedo` and the labels of the
    // steps they would take back or forward.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-history-readout')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      const show = (state) => {
        const undo = state.canUndo ? (state.undoLabel ?? 'available') : 'nothing';
        const redo = state.canRedo ? (state.redoLabel ?? 'available') : 'nothing';
        output.textContent = `Undo: ${undo} · Redo: ${redo}`;
      };
      show({ canUndo: flow.canUndo, canRedo: flow.canRedo });
      listen(flow, 'tp-history-change', (event) => show(event.detail));
    }
    // Consumer bars: a child Button calls the public method its `data-flow-call` names; one with
    // `data-flow-enabled` follows that boolean getter on every history change.
    const commands = [...flow.querySelectorAll('[data-flow-call]')];
    if (commands.length) {
      const refresh = () => {
        for (const button of commands)
          if (button.dataset.flowEnabled) button.disabled = !flow[button.dataset.flowEnabled];
      };
      for (const button of commands)
        listen(button, 'click', () => flow[button.dataset.flowCall]('trigger-press'));
      listen(flow, 'tp-history-change', refresh);
      refresh();
    }
    // Live readout: proposals with their reason and change types, commits, connections.
    if (flow.hasAttribute('data-output')) {
      const output = readout(flow);
      output.textContent = summary(flow.value);
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
        if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
        const types = [...new Set(event.detail.metadata.changes.map((change) => change.type))];
        const where = event.detail.metadata.nodeId
          ? ` on ${event.detail.metadata.nodeId}${event.detail.metadata.property ? `.${event.detail.metadata.property}` : ''}`
          : '';
        output.textContent = `${event.detail.reason}: ${types.join(', ')}${where}`;
      });
      listen(flow, 'tp-value-commit', (event) => {
        output.textContent = `${summary(event.detail.value)} (committed: ${event.detail.reason})`;
      });
      listen(flow, 'tp-connect', (event) => {
        const { connection } = event.detail;
        output.textContent = `connect: ${connection.source} → ${connection.target}`;
      });
    }
  }
  // A layout switch: the Toggle group's value becomes `autoLayout` and lays the graph out.
  for (const group of root.querySelectorAll('tp-toggle-group[data-layout-switch]')) {
    const flow = root.querySelector(`#${group.getAttribute('data-layout-switch')}`);
    if (!flow) continue;
    listen(group, 'tp-value-change', (event) => {
      const [mode] = event.detail.value;
      if (!mode) {
        event.preventDefault();
        return;
      }
      flow.autoLayout = mode;
      flow.layout(mode);
    });
  }
  // Form submit readout: the document submits as JSON under the widget's name.
  for (const form of root.querySelectorAll('tp-form[data-form-output]')) {
    const output = readout(form);
    listen(form, 'tp-submit', (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const entries = [...event.detail.data.entries()].map(
        ([name, value]) => `${name}=${String(value).slice(0, 72)}…`,
      );
      output.textContent = entries.join('; ') || '(no entries)';
    });
  }
  return () => {
    for (const cleanup of cleanups.splice(0).reverse()) cleanup();
  };
}

items.title: Toolbars and panels
items.description: Panels anchor to the four corners and the middle of the four edges (`top-start`, `top-center`, `top-end`, `center-start`, `center-end`, `bottom-start`, `bottom-center`, `bottom-end`). The built-in bar takes `controls`, `controls-position` and `controls-orientation`; `zoom` is the zoom field: the current level (type a percentage and press Enter) and a menu of fit (Shift+1) and preset levels (100% is Shift+0). Authored `tp-flow-controls` children slotted into any panel are further standard bars the widget keeps in sync (`actions` lists their items; consumer Buttons inside join them), and any other slotted content, such as this Button group calling `selectAll()` and `clearSelection()`, is a consumer bar. Undo and Redo enable as the history fills; `tp-history-change` reports `canUndo`, `canRedo` and the step labels (readout below).

/**
 * A grid of generic action nodes chained left to right and top to bottom, for the read-only
 * dependency viewer.
 * @param {number} count
 * @param {number} [columns]
 * @param {'bezier' | 'straight' | 'step' | 'smoothstep' | 'orthogonal'} [kind]
 */
export function generateDocument(count, columns = 25, kind) {
  const nodes = [];
  const edges = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    nodes.push({
      id: `n${i}`,
      type: 'action',
      position: { x: (i % columns) * 300, y: Math.floor(i / columns) * 160 },
      data: {},
      label: `Node ${i}`,
    });
    if (i > 0)
      edges.push({
        id: `g${i}`,
        source: `n${i - 1}`,
        sourcePort: 'out',
        target: `n${i}`,
        targetPort: 'in',
        ...(kind ? { kind } : {}),
      });
    if (i >= columns)
      edges.push({
        id: `v${i}`,
        source: `n${i - columns}`,
        sourcePort: 'out',
        target: `n${i}`,
        targetPort: 'in',
        ...(kind ? { kind } : {}),
      });
  }
  return { version: 1, nodes, edges };
}
